new_apis: All Owner/Watchdog/WifiControl APIs and TransportRequestWifiMode/ConfigureWifiBoot/ReleaseWifiStartupGate are 本轮新增; obsolete synchronous WifiInit/Send/SendControlReply call paths removed.

CAPS2?.semantics: Capability only, not initialized/ready. Root added caps2_v1 to PROTO; actual three-backend limit test owned by root.

semantics: One owner snapshot; requested/output/backend are distinct.
initErr is the lazy owner RESOURCE bootstrap result (payload/timer/task); backend AP errors are WIFIREQ err/cleanupErr and guard evidence. resources=0 with no attempt is not a live backend.
AP ok=1 requires latest applied request, outputGate and ready backend, no quarantine. OFF ok=1 is logical gate applied only; radio may still be running.
v/requested derive the same owner snapshot, never a fresh mode stamped onto old state.
Times are monotonic microseconds. No call => start/deadline/age unknown; no quarantine => detected unknown.
active refers to the isolated owner SDK call, not radio/bus status or isolated RX waiting.

err is first local transaction/guard error; cleanupErr independently records unestablished cleanup (INVALID_STATE) or first cleanup timeout/error. sdkErr/errno/returned are actual most recent SDK return, separate from timeout.
completionKnown is the frozen quarantined call completion; a late actual return changes this evidence but never clears quarantine.
held includes WRITING/PENDING/OWNED slots. No claim that a timeout cancelled SDK or radio is off.
Latest request only; WIFIREQ?<id> e.g. WIFIREQ?17 reads exact nonzero decimal u32 id.
Unknown/evicted result => known=0,outcome=unknown,reason=not_cached; never substitutes another request.
One active + two cached terminal records. Terminal commits once. OFF may supersede active AP but cannot rewrite a failed/quarantined/applied cached request.
completedUs is unknown while pending/running. AP applied requires required calls, sockets and RX-task creation actually succeeded in matching config epoch; no station/PC receipt implication.
Three separate commands WIFIQ?D, WIFIQ?L, WIFIQ?C; counters boot-scoped.

queued is copied owner admission, not legacy sent. sent/old Transport wifiDataSent/wifiLogSent/wifiCtrlTx increment only actual full sendto return; late full returns count and guard late evidence persists.
rejected is owner admission failure; dropped also includes expired/stale/partial/SDK failures. These are overlapping local counters, not independent PC loss.
An in-flight timeout leaves completion unknown; do not invent a physically lost datagram.
driverAcceptedBytes is u64, other counters u32 modulo wrap; bounded deltas, no cross-boot comparison.

commands.WIFI=AP: ACK ver=2 accepted=1 pending=1 ok=0 id/epoch until applied; task may complete before ACK formatting, in which case exact cached result reports it. Same already-ready configuration gets a new idempotent applied terminal, no SDK call. Rejected bootstrap/busy/quarantine returns accepted=0,id=0 and error.
commands.WIFI=OFF: Immediate output-gate terminal with new id/epoch; no close/stop/deinit/task delete. Does not clear active SDK/phase/deadline/held slot or quarantine.
commands.terminal: WTERM uses WIFIREQ fields. Best-effort priority Serial plus observed lifecycle queue, at most3 attempts200ms apart; queued not PC delivery. Terminal may precede/lag ACK. Query has no side effects.

notes: All are local policy; HIL qualification pending. Queue TTL min(original protected deadline, current local deadline), never refreshed.

TTL forbids overdue send start; it is NOT a promise to reclaim pending slots within1s under persistent CTRL pressure or a quarantined owner. Slots stay bounded and retained until real ownership proof.
Observer samples time under same mux, preventing stale-before-new-call false quarantine; no SDK/log/free/reset in callback.

resources.default_off: No Wi-Fi owner task, timer or payload allocation; static metadata remains. Gate is software-only and requires real boot identity plus both root startup reservation participants.
resources.pool_layout: 2x2304 normal DATA/LOG +1x2304 lifecycle +1x512 CTRL; persistent PSRAM|8BIT only, no internal fallback
limits: Metadata/mux/task stacks remain internal; no DMA claim.
Never free/overwrite WRITING or OWNED payload. Release OWNED only after actual return; quarantine retains pending.
Lazy payload/timer/task failure is sticky and queryable; repeated AP never recreates partial live objects.
No HIGH->BLE_COMPAT automatic retry. Existing high/compat buffer configuration unchanged.

DRIVER_INIT returning error may hide internal deinit failure in pinned IDF; retain associated netif/handlers and quarantine. Earlier netif/attach failures use checked cleanup; cleanup failure or timeout quarantines.
App callback only records station events; default SDK event handlers still run in their SDK thread.

evidence.science_wire: real CVRM encoder96 typed cases +15 protocol golden CRC unchanged; no BLE source change

remaining: Independent reviewer gate and actual ESP-IDF build required.
Actual AP success may be blocked by real internal heap. NO_MEM is evidence, not reason to enlarge stack/buffers or claim radio shutdown.
HIL memory, stack watermarks, radio coexistence and real PC reception remain unmeasured by this child.
